conditions: The standard import machinery needs a search for the named child and an ordinary attribute lookup reports that the resolved parent module has no __path__.
limitations: An absent attribute is different from an accessible empty path. A cached child or other exceptions from custom attribute access fall outside the claim.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or a material counterexample.

statement: The Python 3.13.0 import reference documents that an uncached submodule or subpackage search raises ModuleNotFoundError when the resolved parent module lacks the required __path__ attribute.
